rulings.subject: Composite Game Problem profile: primary-led, with the secondary's stronger requirements kept as explicit findings
words: I support your proposed primary-led interpretation for the review pathway.

The Primary Game Problem should retain responsibility for the dominant learning intention. Secondary Game Problems should contribute additional requirements without silently replacing or redefining the primary problem.
Preserve each Game Problem's original CAR profile, role and provenance.
Retain the strongest-necessity merge as a union view showing all requirements and their sources.
When the Secondary Game Problem rates a requirement more strongly, retain that difference as an explicit finding.
Do not automatically promote the stronger secondary requirement into the effective primary-led profile.
Where no approved relationship establishes how to reconcile the difference, report insufficient evidence.
For A05, this means retaining Create Space as the primary problem, while preserving Exploit Space's stronger Functional Object Interaction requirement as an unresolved secondary consideration.
This approves the proposed interpretation for the isolated review pathway, not yet as a permanent amendment to the canonical Composite specification.
Please retain the current CAR Matrix ratings and metadata unchanged.

The longer-term requirement also remains: the dominant Game Problem must ultimately reflect the relevant interaction circumstances, not automatically remain Create Space in every Progress the Attack situation.

rulings.subject: Possession Stabilization context: development continues; identity, transitions, scoring and TA02 routing held
words: I support continuing the development of Possession Stabilization as a proposed ninth Representative Performance Context.
However, I'm not yet approving its full canonical identity, transition amendments or scoring structure.
The new context and any live TA02 routing changes remain on hold pending this review.
rulings.engineUse: None. The proposed context stays out of the engine; TA02 resolves on its approved routing, and the open decision OPEN-D2-POSSESSION-STABILIZATION below is carried on its result.

rulings.subject: Game Form relationships are compatibility information; our orderings withdrawn; the declaration gate kept, its exclusions reported as no governed relationship
words: I agree with your recommendation to treat the current context strengths and Game Form primary/secondary declarations as compatibility information unless approved knowledge explicitly establishes a preference.
Please withdraw the developer-authored orderings that imply otherwise.
Where a Game Form has no governed relationship with the resolved primary Game Problem, I agree that it should remain excluded from automatic selection for now.
However, that exclusion should be reported as no governed relationship established, not as proof that the Game Form is ecologically unsuitable.
For A05, please retain GF2, GF3 and GF7 as compatible alternatives, with insufficient evidence to prefer one.
I do not want us to author an arbitrary preference merely to resolve the tie.

If additional knowledge eventually establishes why one form may be better suited under particular circumstances, that preference should be conditional, source-grounded and justified by its relevance to the intended learning problem.
The missing defending-goal relationships can remain a separate knowledge-population finding.
rulings.withdraws: selection-basis.json: the three orderings (context relationship strength, context relationship type, form declaration) and the Pareto dominance rule. The file is deleted from the stage; the repository history keeps it.

rulings.subject: Affordance vocabulary: four reclassifications confirmed, one provisional; classifications of meaning only
words: I confirm the four previously agreed reclassifications:
I also provisionally accept Protect Space → GP-012 as the corresponding Game Problem reference.
These are classifications of what the labels mean, not automatic approvals of the legacy Game Form or realization relationships in which those labels appear.
Where a legacy label conflicts with a declared canonical Game Problem reference, the approved canonical identity should govern, and the discrepancy should remain documented.
The four CAR representations remain the canonical affordance requirements.
Please continue to hold the ambiguous labels and legacy affordance codes as unresolved. No additional mapping or library transfer is authorized simply to eliminate an unresolved entry.
rulings.engineUse: None. Recorded as data only. No reader of the stage uses these classifications, and no Game Form or realization row is changed or reinterpreted by them.

rulings.subject: Conditions of use: entry structure approved; W-H1 and W-H2 authorized as a paired, test-only comparison; N-H1 deferred; widening on the review pathway within the coach's available space
words: I approve the proposed knowledge-entry structure, including evidence classification, source standing, intended influence, assumptions, limitations, field-evidence status and permitted engine use.

Please distinguish accepted conceptual or structural principles from empirically validated effects. A statement drawn from a candidate or reference-only source should retain that provenance even if we approve its use as a design premise.
For the next demonstration, I authorize W-H1 and W-H2 as a paired, test-only comparison of conditional hypotheses.
Conditions where increasing width might invite space creation because defenders can still organize, shift and contest.
Conditions where additional width might instead provide usable space that already exists, making exploitation the more immediate problem.
The deciding circumstances must be explicitly supplied as test assumptions.
The engine should not claim to infer actual defensive organization or functional available space from pitch dimensions and player numbers alone.
Please do not represent either hypothesis as empirically established or eligible for production selection.
I would defer N-H1 as a causal hypothesis until we've evaluated the width comparison. Numerical relationships may still participate in structural checks and uncertainty reporting.

For the widening experiment, I approve using a proposed configuration of the activity's playing width on the isolated review pathway, provided it remains within the coach's available-space limits and any proposed adjustment is explicit.
No new canonical width row or production configuration change is authorized.
Where the conditions cannot be evaluated, return insufficient evidence rather than invent a numerical threshold.
I also support retaining continuous play as a baseline representative condition where applicable, separate from specific Interaction Regulations.

rulings.subject: Relevance rules: structural preconditions test-only; integrity conditions 01-05 required, 06-08 breach descriptions; framework principles for testing only
words: I support your corrected classification and the principle that compatibility must never be presented as demonstrated relevance.
A rationale must record the knowledge that actually influenced a decision.
A structural condition does not prove that an affordance will emerge.
An inferred relationship must retain its evidence status.
Unsupported element-to-affordance joins must not be promoted into authoritative selection rules.
Any claimed relevance must be distinguishable from structural compatibility and from a hypothesis about player responses.

I agree that the ball as task object and the opposing team as competitor can serve as explicit structural preconditions in the isolated tests, without being treated as sufficient evidence of ecological relevance.
I also agree with treating GA-001 integrity conditions 01–05 as required conditions and 06–08 as descriptions of breaches, subject to confirming the original wording.
For now, I approve the E7 classification approach and the non-causal framework principles for further testing, not a blanket promotion of every draft rule into authoritative knowledge.

Please provide a rule-level source and status check before enabling the remaining rules, particularly any that could exclude a design or claim that a selected environmental element serves an intended affordance.

rulings.subject: A bounded, review-only demonstration using D1, D3, D5 and D6
words: I authorize a bounded, review-only demonstration using the D1, D3, D5 and D6 directions above.
Please distinguish what the engine can establish through approved knowledge from what it can demonstrate only through test-only hypotheses.
This does not authorize the full implementation of Steps 3–5, production relevance joins, live routing changes, or coach-facing deployment.

You may also cite the Populated Game Problem Library's Create Space boundary statement in audit and review traces as reference knowledge, provided its status remains explicit. It should not be converted into an executable causal selection rule merely by being cited.
